@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+def artifact_route(
+    source: tuple[str, ...], destination: tuple[str, ...]
+) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Return the operations to move between two nodes in a report tree."""
+    shared = 0
+    for source_label, destination_label in zip(source, destination):
+        if source_label != destination_label:
+            break
+        shared += 1
+
+    return ("leave",) * (len(source) - shared) + tuple(
+        f"enter:{label}" for label in destination[shared:]
+    )
diff --git a/testing/test_artifact_route.py b/testing/test_artifact_route.py

@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from _pytest.artifact_route import artifact_route
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("source", "destination", "expected"),
+    [
+        (("report", "old", "leaf"), ("report", "new"), ("leave", "leave", "enter:new")),
+        (
+            ("old", "leaf"),
+            ("new", "leaf"),
+            ("leave", "leave", "enter:new", "enter:leaf"),
+        ),
+        (("report",), ("report",), ()),
+        (("report", "leaf"), ("report",), ("leave",)),
+        (("report",), ("report", "leaf"), ("enter:leaf",)),
+        ((), (), ()),
+        ((), ("report", "leaf"), ("enter:report", "enter:leaf")),
+        (("report", "leaf"), (), ("leave", "leave")),
+        (
+            ("report", ".", "leaf"),
+            ("report", "..", "a/b", r"a\b", "C:", ".", ""),
+            (
+                "leave",
+                "leave",
+                "enter:..",
+                "enter:a/b",
+                r"enter:a\b",
+                "enter:C:",
+                "enter:.",
+                "enter:",
+            ),
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_artifact_route(
+    source: tuple[str, ...], destination: tuple[str, ...], expected: tuple[str, ...]
+) -> None:
+    assert artifact_route(source, destination) == expected
notes:
Counted the longest common prefix by comparing labels directly, then emitted leaves and enters for the unmatched suffixes. No filesystem access or path normalization is used.
